1. (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a plurality of network nodes of a local contention neighborhood of a random access network, wherein a first node is configured to transmit to a second node at an access attempt percentage, and wherein each of the nodes is configured to provide an __indication__ of its inter-node interference to __the other nodes in the plurality__, and wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage to transmit to the second node based on one of the provided indicia.

3. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference comprises an indicia of transmission success between the __first node and the__ second node.

4. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage based on the indicia of inter-node interference of the first node divided by an indicia of inter-node interference of __other nodes in the plurality__. 

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13, comprising the first access point, wherein the first access point is configured to broadcast the __dynamic weight of the second node__ to the first node.

17. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13, comprising a second access point, wherein the second node communicates with the second access point and the first node interferes with communication between the second node and the second access point, __wherein the first node is configured to provide feedback on its access attempt percentage to the second access point__.
